notes.title: Exiori v1.4 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/5e5fbcf2bf17ffbb85e63b4a9fc5b53af63df0ba.png[/img]
Hello and welcome to Exiori's Final Update. It's been a long road with tons of effort and lots of hardship, but the end is finally here. Even though the game has been finished for awhile, the promises are now mostly kept.

Please keep in mind that if the sides of the window are black, please consider selecting Fullscreen in the options.

Without anymore wait, here is what is new:

-Added in the rest of Female Krosuji's NFSW content. You can access it in the Yukino Kingdom.

-You can now unlock the Developer Room (Gallery) for Female Krosuji and unlock the threesome scene. (The Gallery has been in the game for Male Krosuji for a very long time now).

-Changed the Developer Room (Gallery)'s music.
(Maria is playable in the room).

-Maria Kojiryu is now briefly playable in the main story.

-Fixed some grammar.

-Updated a ton of the old plugins, including the save core one. (Hopefully this fixes the issue some people were having).

<Recap of Soneraka Online v1.4 Update>

-Updated the U.I. in Soneraka Online. Fixed some bugs.

-Added in Maria Kojiryu (Solenars Edge Rebirth) to Soneraka Online as
a playable character.

-Changed the title screen music for Soneraka Online.

-Took out some shortcuts.

-Increased the level cap from level 60 to 70.

<Recap of Soneraka Online v1.4 Update>

Please note: For those of you who are experiencing crashes due to your anti-virus marking the game as a false positive and quarantining the game's files.

Please consider white-listing or changing your anti-virus. I can 100 percent say with absolute certainty that I do NOT know how to produce a virus nor would I ever want to.

It would make no sense what-so-ever to ruin all the hard work and money that has been put into this game for that. I know this issue doesn't affect most people and there are some who have fixed it on their end.

Hopefully this update has made it easier for you to play again, otherwise please change your anti-virus. I highly suggest using Avira.

Lastly, I hope this work will be appreciated by all for what it's worth.
If you enjoyed this game, please consider leaving a review. You may not think it matters and that you shouldn't leave one. But, trust me, it means way more than you think. Especially if you can unlock Steam emotes/cards from it.

Please consider playing other Team Syukino games if you enjoyed Exiori. Have a nice day and an even more wonderful life! Thanks for having faith that this game would be completed and promises kept from the Kick-starter onward. -Syukino

*Final note: This game wasn't allowed to be on Nutaku due to certain 3rd party appearances. That's why there won't be a Nutaku release.

notes.title: Exiori Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/4b281f33dd853c4c0ac45e938b99f6f3f5789129.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/81222fba109868824019462296245c9a74c416c8.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/eb685ba620f13143cc2abca377bb566660913742.png[/img]

Thanks to a generous donor, Female Krosuji now exists.
Of course she will need to be implemented into the game with her own route and it will be almost like making the game over again with all the changes that need to happen. She still needs her H scenes and her battle sprite. All of this will be costly, and a bunch of hard work. I don't have any information on when this will be available.

The game will also be repackaged with Euclyca and sold separately without the NSFW content in the future with a different store page on Steam. This game will be unaffected by this change and the NSFW content will remain in this one. This also means you are more likely to be able to play as Female Krosuji in the SFW version before you will get a chance to in this one as there won't be any need for H scenes.

Why is this happening? So that people from other countries and areas that are blocked from enjoying the games on Steam due to it's NSFW content can play them. They will be able to see and play the games, as they weren't able to before. To them, these games don't show up for them, so they haven't seen a new Team Syukino JRPG in a long time other than Pixel Boy.

These games were always games first and porn later. This also means that super easy mode won't be in the SFW version as there is no need for it. The side bosses will actually serve a purpose without doing that mode as they grant extra rewards and EXP. Super easy mode was just for casuals to be able to rush to the porn. The game isn't even hard to begin with, but I understand that these types of games aren't for everyone and some people just want the NSFW content.

Well, you can download the porn for a price on itch.io or roll the dice. Also, Elruna part 2 would hopefully come out in both versions for free. It will hopefully include some more H scenes between Silmera and Elruna for example, given that money is good in the future.

Anima cards will be added to both the SFW and NSFW versions as well in the future, making the games even easier. Also, Euclyca *may get a Male Ashe x Nino scene in the future as well. Luca from Falnarion Tactics III may also be included in Soneraka Online. Again, this depends on money available.

So, share with your friends, leave reviews, buy and play the games if you want this content to exist. All it took was one person and Female Krosuji exists. Imagine if multiple people did the same. The content would be here already for everyone to enjoy.

Anyways, happy holidays and let's look forward to a better year next year!

notes.title: Soneraka Online
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/f4c4dbccb2c454ba21584202914595c17ea34db5.png[/img]
Team Syukino is currently developing an online multiplayer mode for Exiori. This mode will be added in a separate launch option as soon as it is playable. It is undergoing heavy testing and will be in alpha stage for awhile. It will be a free addition to those who already own Exiori on both Itch.io and Steam. The lobby size will be up to 20 players and you will be able to do what you wish individually. You can join other players in combat and manage your own characters' equipment and stats. Everyone has their own inventory, their own money, etc. But, beware as it is a bit of a rogue-like. If you die, you get ejected from the game and you lose everything including your money. You can rejoin the host's game, but you will need to be revived by sleeping at an inn or using a revival item. You will have to find one or trade with another player to get one. If the host dies, everyone dies. Then you have to start a new game. You can have up to eight characters in a party in battle. New U.I. and other features will be added in the future, you can use emotes, trade with other players and fight various enemies and use a chat service to communicate with your team. You can volunteer for this testing and join live voice channels in the discord to communicate with your teammates in the lobby. There are future plans to add in pvp, being able to party up with others outside of battle, more custom commands, etc. You have around 20+ characters from Exiori, Euclyca and Elruna as well as other cameo works to pick and choose from. There is a pet system where you can choose between four different pets if you have the coin. They will join your party and will help you level up. The entire world of Teseldaima with it's cameo worlds will be explorable. The worlds of Estellium Legends and Euclyca will also be added in the future. So, three giant worlds with multiple explorable areas. The kickstarter will also support many new additions such as new pets, characters and outfits. This mode will be worked on for awhile and will undergo much testing. When this mode is added, logging in is easy, just create a user name (no password) and join a hosted room. When this mode is fully completed one day, a grand prize will be given out to the first player to reach the end game content and defeat it. Other undisclosed options may or may not be available in the future.

The Poochum will be a new pet and Silmera will be a new playable character. The custom characters from the higher tiers will eventually be added in as well as playable options.

Hope to see you there!

notes.title: Important Changes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/083b77202258f389c50b6ca9465bed32f4288e5f.png[/img]

Exiori was originally planned at the start to be eight chapters. But, sometimes during the production of games, things change. It will be announced that Exiori will only be seven chapters. The story can end comfortably with just seven chapters. (The game is technically eight with the chapter 0:prologue).

Eight chapters would feel too convoluted and dragged out at this point. The game can end as intended without having that extra chapter. It would feel wrong to stuff an entire chapter full of filler nonsense that doesn't do justice to the plot into the game. In other news, most if not all of the free Elruna content will be pushed out after or around release.

That is the bad or bittersweet news depending on how you take it. The good news is that with this choice, the game will be much closer to release and can be expected in early 2023, depending if artists behave and deliver on their promises.

Despite this change, this is still the longest Team Syukino game by far and it has been a pleasure working on this project. I have heard that several people like the story. I appreciate that, and even through my struggles in life, I appreciate those who have stood by and continued to support this project and eagerly await it's release.

In other news; The voted least favorite character is Alfura. Meaning, that she is a good villain. For that, I am proud.

The story of Exiori will end in the next story update. The story of the series will end with the last part of Elruna, so stay tuned and come back to the game in the future even if you have finished the main plot of Exiori.

The winner of the artist contest will be announced soon (if there are any contestants). Also there has been one piece of artwork hidden from the public that will be featured in chapter seven. It is super spoiler territory so it will not be shown publicly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/cb728af5c3ae01a440e7800705ffc4e4881c6492.png[/img]
In other news; Estellium Legends II has been pushed onto another developer with some guidance from me. I am overseeing the project, but they are mainly developing it. This will allow it to be released much quicker. I will also now focus more on Exiori. Not much can be said on Estellium Legends II at this time, but it will feature over 100 playable characters including those from Exiori, Euclyca and Elruna.

Happy Holidays and a Happy New Year! -Syu

notes.title: Exiori Chapter 6: (Hope) Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/69b7964cf4ecbc863130121e32caeac6c73e4f08.png[/img]

Hello and welcome to Chapter 6 of Exiori. Exiori has come a long way and has taken the second longest to make in all of Team Syukino's history. The first being Solenars Edge. Exiori is close to being finished and has only two chapters left. No speculation on the full release, but it will happen as soon as Chapter 8 is released in the near future.

Due to a series of unfortunate events, including trouble with the main artist of Elruna that required them to be replaced. Elruna will no longer be a standalone game and will instead be a smaller game than originally intended. It will be merged with Exiori and take place in Normellia and after the events of Euclyca and Exiori. This inclusion will be added in for free and will not be locked behind a paywall for an additional charge. You may select Elruna upon entering a new game at the title screen. Elruna should pop up as one of the select-able options. Elruna will be added in at different times and broken into three separate parts. As of this release; Chapter 6, Elruna part one is not out and is it not fully playable at this time. Elruna parts will be released around the time of an Exiori chapter release. Sometimes they will release on their own. It is suggested that you do not start Elruna until after you have finished all eight chapters of Exiori. Have fun!

Here is what is new in Exiori!

-The story is continued!

-Changed the appearance of Krosuji's Diary at the start of the game.

-The Last areas in Teseldaima;
The Kingdom of Jern and The Giving Tree are now unlocked!

-Raised the price of Potent Tiok from 200 to 800 Yeno.

-A NSFW scene between Krosuji and Ibuki is accessible in the story.
 *Will later be added to the Gallery/Dev Room*.

-You may now complete the side quest for the Frinkle Pages if
you have found them all.

-Fixed the duplicate character problem at the lighthouse in
Gruntrotto.

-For the price of 700,000k Yeno, you may purchase the Solenars Edge for Yukami at a secret shop within the game. The location will not be revealed and is now within the game as of Chapter 6.
Happy Hunting!

-Fixed Mysperus's map name to display.

-Locked Alfura's Orb in the slot when you play as her, it was
unlocked as an error.

-Level cap is now level 80, an increase from level 70.
Your characters can now get even stronger!

-Elruna is now merged with Exiori and will be playable in the near future and select-able when starting a new game from the drop down menu.

Until next time~

notes.title: Exiori Chapter 4 (The Truth) Out Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42215292/bb7787273a787b3ec0fc5838bcacc93af71d7853.png[/img]

Welcome to the long awaited Exiori Chapter 4 (The Truth).
It's been awhile and I am proud to say that this long hill climb is
over. This game is now 50% complete. We are now at the half-way mark!

The second half will be a lot easier to make and SHOULD come out much
quicker than the first half. Given that life is kind.

But, it will still take some time especially Chapter 5 due to those planned areas.
Chapters 6-8 should be easier to make as most of the ground work should be laid out by then.
Still, it will take some time.

Thank you for your support in Exiori and please look forward to more content in the future!

What is new:

-The NSFW character questlines are here!
Have fun interacting with your favorite characters, learning more
about them and then... well. You know the rest ;3.

-The story has continued, two new worlds are introduced.
Nerfelo (Falnarion Tactics Series) and Alcornagia (Solenars Edge Series). Fight your way through them and say hello to some familiar faces that are featured at the ends of Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn and Falnarion Tactics II.

-Blood Magic is now a thing and will be used by certain
characters with Blood type weapons and skills. Blood is now
a new element. Most Blood type things cause Bleeding which stacks
up to massive damage.

-The level cap for the main characters has risen from level 60 to 70.
You can now get stronger than before.

-Added in more Frinkle Pages to find.

-Added in a Developer Room which is basically a place to test out battles with almost any character you want, alive or dead. You can also view the NSFW stuff here in a gallery type thing.
You need to finish all of the NSFW quests in order to unlock it.
You must beat chapter 4 and get the airship before you can access the dev room.
Once you've done that, interact with the fireplace.

-You can now interact with the prayer statue and obtain blessings
from it in Teseldaima.

-Gruntrotto is now available.

-Changed the overworld music for Teseldaima.

-Airship is now unlocked for use at the end of the chapter.

-Palmu Village is now available.

-Mooshroom Forest is now available.

-The final Soul Gem can now be utilized.

-Added in more character bios.

-Krosuji now has a revival skill that he can have from the
start of the game; Defibrillator.

<Already mentioned, but still added earlier in this Chapter>

-The last of the Euclyca flashbacks are now complete.
No more will happen going forward in the game's story.

-Utalia Temple is now accessible.

-The Kraken Arena is now unlocked.
You must talk to Aren in his home before you can access it.
Complete all ranks of the Arena to unlock the Demonic Heart as
well as the Blood Scythe for Temi.

-More playable characters for moments in the story.

-Other hidden goodies.

<Fixes>

-Buffed the ATK of the Blood Scythe slightly.

-Nerfed a boss at the start of chapter 3, slightly.

-The skill Well Done no longer gives Earth Attributes to the
target, but has a chance to cause Burn instead.

-Temi's map sprite has a tail now, which was missing before.

-Fixed some wrong skill animations.

-Mitsu's LB has been changed from Total Eclipse to Total Eclipse Nightmare. Same thing, just a name change.

-Nerfed Yukami's Ult; Send to Heaven, as it was way too strong.

-Fixed a problem where a future cutscene would show up in Oroon Cave too early if you went there with Lumina in Chapter 0. Due to this fix, the cutscene may play again in Oroon Cave if you are going through the area. On a new playthrough, this won't be an issue. If this happens on your continued one, then just skip it.

<Already mentioned before, but still added in this chapter>

-Added in some equipment and revival items to the Mooshroom shop keeper in the Hundred Acre Hood. (Make sure to use Pooh's Pure Intentions skill to revive if you don't have items in that area). 
Hint: Use your Limit Breaks like crazy and try to get them quickly if you are fighting a tough enemy.

-Lumina now tells you to look for the Obeskia Herb bushes when you first interact with the rock if you aren't supposed to yet. This will help people that are confused and don't know where to go.

-Certain state skills like buffs and debuffs, now have an animation to accompany them while they are active. Just like in Euclyca.

<Last call>

If you would like to add in a custom character in Exiori. You may do so by requesting one. There are only a limited amount of slots for characters and it will cost you money via paypal. This has been done before as Nino, Halcyone and Ibuki are custom characters that have been paid to be in the game. Once chapter 5 is released. No more custom characters will be accepted. This is limited time offer. *Offer limited to only four people*.

Thanks for being here. -Syukino.
